title: Supreme Court issues notice to Centre, states on SCBA plea for inclusive representation, support of women lawyers
description: The Supreme Court on Friday issued notice on a petition filed by the Supreme Court Bar Association (SCBA) seeking a range of structural reforms to ensure that women advocates across the country are able to practice law with dignity and on equal terms with their male counterparts. [Supreme Court Bar Association v.
